# Muse Gadget SDK

Source commit `a5f809f621c4cbdbd37336fe17e7cdb74cebf3fe` in [Meta’s Muse Gadget SDK](https://github.com/facebookincubator/muse-gadget-sdk).
The Apache 2.0 license and upstream attribution apply to the vendored code.

SwB uses the Bluetooth pairing, Noise link, token refresh, and text chat paths.
SwB supplies the transport, identity, and credential storage.
The adaptation removes device file state, media, wakeword, command execution, and file operations.
